meal.title: Edit Meal
meal.itemsHint: Tap any number to edit it. Editing grams rescales that item's macros proportionally.
meal.noItems: No items left — add one back with "Fix results" or cancel.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.emptySavedBody: Tap the heart on any meal to keep it here for one-tap logging.
favourites.emptyRecentBody: Foods you log will show up here so you can log them again.

exercise.title: Exercise
exercise.notAWorkout: That didn't look like a workout — pick below instead.
exercise.creditNote: {credit} kcal of that is added to today's budget. Burn estimates run high, so only part of it counts.
exercise.kcalHint: From your watch, a gym machine or a fitness app.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.loading: Looking for three ideas that fit…
ideas.emptyBody: You're out of room for today — ideas come back tomorrow.

us.title: Us
us.nearGoalNote: “Near goal” means within 10% of that person's calorie goal.
us.glassesOfWater: {n} glass of water|{n} glasses of water

profile.exerciseCreditNote: When on, {percent}% of what you burn is added to your daily budget.

errors.offline: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.quota: Daily free AI limit reached — add the meal manually.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

doodle.strongSub: {streak}-day streak. Keep logging and he keeps growing.|{streak}-day streak. Keep logging and he keeps growing.
doodle.strongSubNew: Log a few days in a row and he starts growing.
doodle.wellFedSub: Over the goal today — no drama, it resets tomorrow.
doodle.idleSub: Nothing logged in {days} days. The streak stopped.

list.emptyToday: Tap + to add your first meal of the day

auth.inviteHint: Ask whoever set up the app for this.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.forgot: Forgotten your password? Whoever set up the app can reset it for you.
auth.fillBoth: Enter a username and a password.
auth.signOutConfirm: Sign out on this phone? Your meals stay in the cloud.

weight.title: Weight
weight.hint: One reading a day. Same time, same conditions works best — first thing in the morning is the usual choice.
weight.emptyBody: Add a reading and the trend builds from there.

edit.amountHint: Change the amount and every number below rescales with it.
edit.amountHintFirst: How much was this? Enter it once, then changing it rescales the numbers below.
edit.name: Name

todayTab.title: Today
todayTab.emptyBody: Tap + to log your first meal.

weight2.goalHint: Leave empty to remove the goal.

myth.label: Myth or fact?
myth.tapToReveal: Tap to see what the evidence says

doodlePick.title: Your doodle
doodlePick.hint: Your doodle is drawn by Nano Banana, based on your profile photo if you've set one on the Us tab.
doodlePick.needsBilling: Nano Banana couldn't draw it: image generation needs billing turned on for the Gemini key. The built-in doodle is used meanwhile; it'll try again in a week.

voice.title: Describe Meal
voice.hint: Say what you ate and how much — “two eggs, a slice of toast and a coffee with milk”. You can fix the text before analysing.
voice.denied: Microphone access is off. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, or type instead.
voice.unsupported: Voice isn't available in this browser. Type the meal instead.
voice.failed: Couldn't hear that. Try again, or type the meal.
voice.empty: Nothing came through. Try again a little closer to the phone.
voice.subhead: Describe what you ate and the AI will estimate the calories and macros.
voice.placeholder: e.g. banana smoothie with two scoops of protein powder and blueberries
voice.tip: Include quantities where you can — "two scoops", "a handful" — and the estimate gets a lot better.

plate.open: Check this portion on a plate
plate.title: Check your portion
plate.sub: Drawn to scale on a 26 cm dinner plate. Compare it with what's in front of you.
plate.overflow: That's more than a plate holds.
plate.approx: Approximate — sizes come from typical densities, so a fluffy salad or a dense steak can look a little off.

social.noteHint: It shows on their Home instead of the usual message.
social.shareEmpty: Nothing shared yet. Tap ↗︎ on a meal with a photo to share it.
social.feedRule: Photo meals only, 3 a day each. Posts and comments delete themselves after 7 days.

accuracy.exHint: Burn estimates from apps and watches usually run high, and your target already allows for everyday activity. Exercise is still logged and shown either way.
accuracy.learnHint: After about two weeks of logging and weighing in, SnapCal works out what you really burn from your own data and sets your target from that.
accuracy.cardUsing: Your target is based on this.
accuracy.cardNotYet: Not used yet — needs a bit more data.
accuracy.cardBuilding: Keep logging meals and weighing in. After about two weeks, SnapCal will show what you really burn here.
accuracy.cardHow: Worked out from {days} days of eating (average {intake} kcal) and your weight trend ({rate} kg a week). It includes your exercise, daily movement and logging habits.
accuracy.cardSkipped: {n} days that looked only partly logged were left out.
accuracy.exNoteOff: Logged, not added to today's budget — burn estimates run high. You can change this in Profile.
accuracy.exNoteOn: {credit} kcal of that is added to today's budget ({pct}% setting in Profile).

invite.title: Invite people
invite.copied: Link copied — send it to the person you're inviting.
invite.hint: Each link lets one person create an account, and stops working after 7 days.
invite.full: All places are taken or already invited.
invite.joinSub: Pick a username and password to join.

bad.used: This invite link has already been used.
bad.expired: This invite link has expired — ask for a new one.

groups.onlyYou: Only you are in {name} so far — invite someone from Profile.

onb.aboutSub: This sets your starting numbers. You can change any of it later.
onb.buildSub: Muscle burns more than fat, so at the same weight two people can need very different amounts. This gets your starting number closer.
onb.buildSlimSub: Not much fat, not much muscle
onb.buildAverageSub: Neither especially lean nor especially muscular
onb.buildLargerSub: Carrying more weight than you'd like
onb.activitySub: Outside of workouts — your job and daily life.
onb.rateNote: Faster isn't better: beyond about 1% of body weight a week you start losing muscle too.
onb.planMacros: Protein {p} g · Carbs {c} g · Fat {f} g
onb.planLean: Worked out from your lean mass ({n} kg), because you told us your build.
onb.planLearn: These are estimates. After about two weeks of logging and weighing in, SnapCal replaces them with what your own data says.

activity.light: On my feet some of the day
activity.moderate: On my feet most of the day
activity.extra: Physical job and training most days

members.title: Who's in which group
members.hint: Tap a group to add or remove someone. People with no group see only themselves.

redo.title: Set up again
redo.hint: Walk through the questions again — useful to switch to pounds and feet, or after a change in build or goal. Your meals, weigh-ins and history are kept.

weekend.aheadBody: Two days that undo four is the most common pattern there is. Log them like any other day and they usually behave.
weekend.saturdayBody: Nothing is off limits today — just log it while you remember. Saturday you log beats Saturday you guess at on Monday.
weekend.sundayBody: One more day. A weekend logged honestly is worth more than a perfect-looking week with two blank days in it.
weekend.withNumber: Over your last {weekends} weekends you've averaged {n} kcal a day more than on weekdays. Not a problem — just worth knowing before Saturday night.
weekend.under: Your weekends actually run {n} kcal a day lighter than your weekdays. Whatever you're doing, keep it.

suggest.title: Suggestion box
suggest.placeholder: Something that would make this better, or something that annoys you…
suggest.sent: Sent — thank you. Aelson sees these.
suggest.hint: Anything: a feature, a bug, a food the AI keeps getting wrong.

scanq.title: Photo quality
scanq.hint: Smaller photos cost less to analyse and store. Saver is enough for most meals; choose Detailed for busy plates with several dishes.

sub.tiny: 384 px · cheapest, weaker on mixed plates

context.title: Add details
context.prompt: Anything the photo can't show — how it was cooked, the real portion, what's underneath.
context.placeholder: e.g. fried in two spoons of oil, the chicken was about 200 g

chipText.oil: fried in about two tablespoons of oil
chipText.nooil: cooked without any oil or butter
chipText.restaurant: a restaurant portion, generous and cooked with plenty of oil
chipText.half: I only ate half of what's in the photo
chipText.grams: the weights below are measured on a scale, keep them

context.beforeHint: Helps a lot when the photo can't show the portion or the oil.

bf.title: Which looks most like you?
bf.sub: Rough is fine — it only sets your starting number, and after two weeks your own data replaces it.
bf.tapeSub: The US Navy method — the most accurate thing you can do at home, usually within about 3 points.
bf.neckHint: Just below the Adam's apple, tape sloping slightly down at the front.
bf.waistHint: At the navel for men; at the narrowest point for women. Relaxed, don't suck in.
bf.hipHint: Around the widest part of the hips and glutes.
bf.invalid: Those measurements don't add up — check the tape.

displayName.title: Your name
displayName.hint: What the others see. Your username stays the same for signing in.

recap.title: Your Friday check-in
recap.none: Your first recommendation arrives Friday morning, based on the 7 days before.
recap.notEnough: You logged {n} days this week. Log at least 3 and Friday's check-in will have specific advice for you.

tray.hint: Tap foods to put them on your plate, then add them all at once.

nutrients.title: Nutrients
nutrients.partial: {n} meal has no nutrient data, so these totals are low.|{n} meals have no nutrient data, so these totals are low.
nutrients.empty: Log a meal to see fiber, sugar, sodium and more.
nutrients.noneShort: No nutrient data — tap to add
nutrients.moreHint: Leave a box empty if you don't know it.
